package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// GetPlanningSnapshot projects one consistent owner read into its private
// whitelist. It creates no planning job, receipt, evidence, or owner mutation.
type GetPlanningSnapshot struct {
	Reader repository.PlanningSnapshotReader
}

func (u GetPlanningSnapshot) Handle(ctx context.Context, studentID, pathID string, input domain.PlanningSnapshotRequest) (domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot, error) {
	if u.Reader == nil || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(studentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(pathID) {
		return domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	request, err := domain.NormalizePlanningSnapshotRequest(input)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	source, err := u.Reader.ReadPlanningSnapshot(ctx, studentID, pathID, request.Targets)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
			return domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrPlanningSnapshotSourceInvalid
		}
		return domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, err
	}
	if source.StudentID != studentID || source.Path.StudentID != studentID || source.Path.ID != pathID {
		return domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrPlanningSnapshotSourceInvalid
	}
	result, err := domain.BuildStudentPlanningSnapshot(source, request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentPlanningSnapshot{}, domain.ErrPlanningSnapshotSourceInvalid
	}
	return result, nil
}
